fusions.name: Still-Water Lunge
fusions.desc: You lunge up to 5 tiles to the target and clamp onto it, dealing 13 damage, rising to 1.5 times that from full reach, and holding it [Stunned] for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Wallowing Roll
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. You roll in the mud, dealing 9 water damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Basking Rest
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Waiting at the Ford
fusions.desc: After 10 seconds without a critical hit, your critical chance rises by 30% for your next strike.
